observation.command:
cd /workspace && nohup bash -c 'docker compose --env-file .env up --wait > /tmp/compose-up.log 2>&1; echo "COMPOSE_EXIT=$?" > /tmp/compose-up.done' &
echo "compose up started, pid $!"
sleep 20
echo "=== compose up log so far ==="; tail -15 /tmp/compose-up.log; echo "=== ps ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"
